items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: if you get the right people, like Eddie Johnson and Nat Jones, and they set those riffs

ctx.x: were playing opposite. Now, he's got -- Wingy got Paul Margs .., besides himself, Floyd O'Brien, I remember that. Either -- I think it was .. And we had every hot musician -- what they called hot -- in that band. No music, it was all head arrangements.

I've done that since then many times, put together ten -- if you get the right people, like Eddie Johnson and Nat Jones, and they set those riffs, you really don't need it. All you have to do is pick the right tempo and the right tune. You don't need it, you can do it. Well, Win did it long before I thought of it. And we just enjoyed ourselves and locked that room up, and locked that band up. They were at our feet. That was that night.

We had a date the next afternoon. The next night was an afternoon gig at the other ballroom there. We stayed up all night listening to music and glorying in being together. You know what they got the next afternoon? The bandleader looked at us and said, what happened? Where was the band that knocked us out the night before? We didn't have nothing, we didn't have no enthusiasm, we had no glow, had nothing but tired bodies reporting for duty. And we were a complete flop. We just -- and this was the other side of…
